content.text: I changed `ProxyMappings.withFixedProxyMapping` in `services/.../httpclient/ProxyMappings.java` so each `NO_PROXY` entry is trimmed and any leading dots are stripped before the match pattern is built. Entries that end up empty are skipped. Before this, `.corp.com` was quoted literally into a pattern that matched nothing, and `" internal.corp.com"` kept its leading space. Now `.corp.com`, `corp.com` and `localhost, internal.corp.com` all bypass the proxy for the domain and its subdomains. I haven't compiled this or run any tests. The AxiomEngine graph wasn't built for this repo, so I found the code with grep instead.
